title: Lipoid Kosmetik launches depigmentation factor - Skin-friendly lightening with liposomal precision
summary: Lipoid Kosmetik is a leading manufacturer of high-quality botanical extracts, actives and natural phospholipid products for the cosmetic and personal care industry. With a clear insight into our consumers’ needs, Lipoid Kosmetik presents Depigmentation Factor, a COSMOS- and NATRUE-approved cosmetic active that combines a full-spectrum bearberry leaf extract with a liposomal carrier system for effective, skin-friendly pigmentation care
